title: October 2026 Risk Failure Audit v2
body:
## Completion published — prices through 2 November
Original audit preserved byte-for-byte at 1ee2c0958b12c821723c1923ddc69bd23a454a55; published baseline tag audit-v2-baseline-20261103 and SHA256 baseline.json. No rewritten history. All new files are under reports/october-risk-failure-audit-v2/completion/.

Latest published checkpoint: 7135c2bdc0653986d93dfcfc66b202a6fb2f741e.

## Data
All11 requested stocks, S&P500/NasdaqComposite/Russell2000, QQQ/SPY/IWM, SOX/SOXX/SMH, VIX and DXY cover44 trading sessions September1–November2. Regular-session stock/ETF requests explicitly exclude pre/post-market. Frozen raw responses, provider URLs, retrieval timestamps, OHLCV/actions and SHA256 included. XNYS calendar/DST verified: November2 open14:30UTC, close21UTC.

Treasury2Y/10Y:42 observations (no October12 or November2). IG/HY:43 (no November2). Missing values are not fabricated. Macro vintages/original release timestamps and full-market breadth remain unavailable. Next-midnight price availability and two-session macro lag are assumptions, not certified PIT evidence; all confirmed_trade_signal fields remain false.

Fed official pages verified via web connector: September16 increase and October28 unchanged, both18:00UTC releases; current-page archive limitation explicit.

## Findings
Frozen rules reproduce October8 sector /October14 QQQ /October16 VIX-change flags. Earlier sector warnings occurred September1/14. Additional QQQ flag October30 and sector flag November2; earliest calendar execution for the latter November3 is outside the test and has no fill price.

On October9 open AMD/NVDA were approximately3.47%/2.26% below the known prior peak: conditional opportunity to reduce before their5% closing thresholds. MU/TSM had already hit5% close on October8; LRCX/NBIS earlier. Warning detection is not proof of investment effectiveness.

## Continuous economic test
Frozen original5%/10% cuts,5bp commission+5bp adverse slippage, next-open fills, additional-session-delay sensitivity and original restoration rules. No October reset used for conclusions. Model portfolio100000USD,11 equal initial capital sleeves, no rebalancing or real-weight inference:
- Buy & Hold90888.56USD; MaxDD21.5175%.
- Trim5%90701.12USD; delta−187.43USD; MaxDD21.4527%.
- Trim10%90513.69USD; delta−374.87USD; MaxDD21.3875%.
Expensive September repurchases leave share deficits and block subsequent risk reductions under the frozen full-restoration rule. Per-stock shares/cash/fees/recovery costs and blocked transitions are published. No economic advantage established.

## AUTO-support and production evidence
Unchanged original Python DecisionEngine executed on synthetic support fixtures: current/future rows can mask support_broken. Importantly include-current fixture still yieldsTRIM via another branch; defect does not generally forbid reduction.
Historical conditional masked flags:5 rows across AVGO/AMAT/LRCX/NBIS; none for AMD/NVDA/MU in this window. Original production input path/causal impact UNKNOWN.

Read-only Railway metadata and bounded filtered logs checked;0 original decision payloads obtained. Empty logs with unknown retention are not HOLD.222 saved research rows, retrospective transitions, and unavailable production actions remain separate. No fabricated fundamentals, positions or orders.

## Tests / reproduction
29/29 original JS checks and29/29 on extended inputs passed in actual Node CLI. Original run reproduced without changing its outputs.20 Python tests passed:2 existing main +18 new completion checks;0 failures,1 environment deprecation warning. Old203/20 research tests not claimed.
Clean worktree fetched from GitHub at dfab255cdbdb0302e4a25cf5f4ecb7baa9f5f051 reproduced all70 published completion files byte-identically;git diff empty.27 raw response SHA256 checks passed. verification.json records the result.

All9 requested documents/tables published in completion/, including Russian investor summary, coverage, chronology, warnings, drawdowns, economics, production evidence, support impact and validation.

## Boundary
Price-history extension complete; definitive production failure attribution and certified PIT conclusions remain blocked by missing original payloads, config/deployment input history, actual holdings/trades, macro vintages and full breadth. No new rules/threshold fitting/Risk Engine v3/Portfolio Protection, production writes/orders, merge or deploy. Draft stays open; stop at audit checkpoint.
